feeds.title: Croatia Week » Food & Wine
feeds.description: Croatia Week is one of the leading Croatian online magazines in English where you can get weekly updates on the news, food, wine, entertainment, business, etc. Just sign up, and weekly news updates will be delivered straight to your inbox, hassle-free. Their section on food and wine features fairs, street food festivals, recipes, festivals and so much more that you will love.

feeds.title: Reci Peci
feeds.description: Sandra Gasparic's blog is the most-read culinary website in Croatia features interesting recipes and ideas for simple and varied dishes. Found in 2010, Sandra combined her love for cooking and passion for writing and created this blog that features honest recipes with ingredients and procedures in each recipe.

feeds.title: Sašina Kuhinja Blog
feeds.description: Sasha's kitchen is a social site for information, communication, education, and entertainment. You can publish, share and discover delicious recipes. You also get to brighten someone's day with your culinary skills, participate in games, and win prizes. Explore the wide range of photo and video recipes and get daily food recommendations.

feeds.title: Frank about Croatia » Wine & Dine
feeds.description: Follow Frank about Croatia's blog and learn Everything you need to know about dining in Croatia: the best restaurants in various Croatian destinations, traditional food, and gastronomy in Croatia.

feeds.title: Croatian Food
feeds.description: Welcome to the traditional Croatian food recipes where you can get recipes for all generations. Here you will find recipes that will help you enjoy any season even better. From starters to main courses and desserts, get all your favorite Croatian recipes in one place with easy-to-cook instructions.

feeds.title: Chasing the Donkey
feeds.description: Chasing the Donkey travel blog shares all the information you need to travel to Croatia, the Balkans, and beyond. You can discover the best places, get the best accommodation, and above all explore the hidden destinations and local food that will enhance your travel experience. The Croatian Recipes section features ethnic recipes that will help you explore Croatia in the comfort of your home.

feeds.title: GoDubrovnik » Wine + Dine
feeds.description: Dubrovnik News Travel portal is your one-stop destination for local news, tourist information, events, wine & food, fashion, and travel information. Live your Game of Thrones fantasy in this majestic spot. Be enthralled from the ancient city walls to the ocean. Know the best places to get fine wine, best restaurants and cafes nearby and the local recipes that you can cook easily.
